thread:
Alex: Kicking off NorthBridge consumer banking POC. Need scoping: primary flows, golden prompt set, eval harness, timeline, pricing asks, and security questionnaire blockers. They prefer Private (VPC + HSM) but are open to a hybrid path. Target: 6 weeks. Who owns which pieces?

Maria: I can lead the eval harness + goldens. Proposed flows: account-opening Q&A (doc retrieval + concise answers), transaction-alert triage (label + action), and intent routing for support chat. Sounds good?

Devon: Agree on flows 1 & 2. Note from legal: no free-text AML/KYC summarization on hosted. If needed, restrict summarization to Private with field redaction.

Samir: Infra constraints: VPC peering + KMS/HSM, no persistent per-token logs. Private works. Need concurrency estimate for sizing.

Alex: Sales estimate: 120 qps peak during demo, 20 sustained. They asked: can we start hosted for onboarding and cutover to Dedicated/Private for production? Also they want PoC discount and clear conversion pricing.

Maria: For goldens: plan ~200 examples per flow, mix of short/long, edge cases, multi-turn. Example templates:```
Account QA:
User: "I uploaded ID and utility bill. Is additional verification needed?"
System: "Check ID expiry and address match. If mismatch, request updated proof."

Transaction triage:
User: "Large outbound to unknown payee at 3AM, balance OK"
System: "Label: Potential Fraud. Action: Hold + escalate."
```
I'll seed a CSV: id, flow, prompt, expected_answer, tags, acceptance_criteria.

Katie: Scoring plan: structured labels exact-match + semantic similarity for free text. 0-1 per example. Pass = avg >= 0.8 on golden set AND >=95% of label examples >=0.9. Regression gate: fail if avg drops >5% vs baseline in A/B. Warn at >3%.

Devon: Add manual QA for top-20 low-confidence outputs (confidence < threshold) during demos. Ops wants a reranker second-pass for critical flows.

Samir: Infra rec: 2 Dedicated GPUs (A40/A100 class) baseline + burst to hosted. Offer a 2-week Dedicated trial for PoC (no commit), then propose 3-month reserved with 20% discount. Legal sign-off needed.

legal: NorthBridge requires SOC2, data residency us-east-1, and has an IP indemnity ask. They've sent a 70-question security questionnaire. Alex, please escalate to security for answers on PII and retention.

Alex: Action items: 1) Maria build seed golden CSV + scoring templates (ETA 3 business days). 2) Samir produce sizing + PoC Dedicated trial proposal (ETA 2 business days). 3) Devon draft redaction/data handling plan for AML flows (ETA 4 days). 4) Katie write scoring rubric + regression gate doc (ETA 3 days). 5) Legal start security questionnaire answers (Alex to share doc). Add blockers here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: create shared Drive folder for goldens and upload seeds by EOD.

Maria: For harness automation add: nightly regression vs baseline, auto-alert if drop >3% (warn) or >5% (fail), and gated deploys for model version changes. I'll include these in harness README.

Alex: Scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow to review first goldens. Call out if ETAs won't hit.

Devon: FYI customer security lead may request on-prem install. If that happens, timeline slips ~2 weeks.

Samir: Adding on-prem contingency to sizing doc.

legal: Uploaded partial answers (Q1-30) to the Drive. Will iterate.

Alex: Closing thread for now, will reopen after sync.
